May perform tasks such as crop baling or hay bucking. May operate stationary equipment to perform post-harvest tasks such as husking, shelling, threshing, and ginning.

rows.title: Helpers--Carpenters
rows.description: Help carpenters by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include using, supplying, or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

rows.title: Helpers--Installation, Maintenance, and Repair Workers
rows.description: Help installation, maintenance, and repair workers in maintenance, parts replacement, and repair of vehicles, industrial machinery, and electrical and electronic equipment. Perform duties such as furnishing tools, materials, and supplies to other workers; cleaning work area, machines, and tools; and holding materials or tools for other workers.

rows.title: Machine Feeders and Offbearers
rows.description: Feed materials into or remove materials from machines or equipment that is automatic or tended by other workers.

rows.title: Shoe Machine Operators and Tenders
rows.description: Operate or tend a variety of machines to join, decorate, reinforce, or finish shoes and shoe parts.

rows.title: Coil Winders, Tapers, and Finishers
rows.description: Wind wire coils used in electrical components, such as resistors and transformers, and in electrical equipment and instruments, such as field cores, bobbins, armature cores, electrical motors, generators, and control equipment.

rows.title: Cooks, Short Order
rows.description: Prepare and cook to order a variety of foods that require only a short preparation time. May take orders from customers and serve patrons at counters or tables.

rows.title: Layout Workers, Metal and Plastic
rows.description: Lay out reference points and dimensions on metal or plastic stock or workpieces, such as sheets, plates, tubes, structural shapes, castings, or machine parts, for further processing. Includes shipfitters.

rows.title: Milling and Planing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
rows.description: Set up, operate, or tend milling or planing machines to mill, plane, shape, groove, or profile metal or plastic work pieces.

rows.title: Operating Engineers and Other Construction Equipment Operators
rows.description: Operate one or several types of power construction equipment, such as motor graders, bulldozers, scrapers, compressors, pumps, derricks, shovels, tractors, or front-end loaders to excavate, move, and grade earth, erect structures, or pour concrete or other hard surface pavement. May repair and maintain equipment in addition to other duties.

rows.title: Outdoor Power Equipment and Other Small Engine Mechanics
rows.description: Diagnose, adjust, repair, or overhaul small engines used to power lawn mowers, chain saws, recreational sporting equipment, and related equipment.

rows.title: Patternmakers, Wood
rows.description: Plan, lay out, and construct wooden unit or sectional patterns used in forming sand molds for castings.

rows.title: Septic Tank Servicers and Sewer Pipe Cleaners
rows.description: Clean and repair septic tanks, sewer lines, or drains. May patch walls and partitions of tank, replace damaged drain tile, or repair breaks in underground piping.

rows.title: Signal and Track Switch Repairers
rows.description: Install, inspect, test, maintain, or repair electric gate crossings, signals, signal equipment, track switches, section lines, or intercommunications systems within a railroad system.

rows.title: Carpet Installers
rows.description: Lay and install carpet from rolls or blocks on floors. Install padding and trim flooring materials.

rows.title: Insulation Workers, Floor, Ceiling, and Wall
rows.description: Line and cover structures with insulating materials. May work with batt, roll, or blown insulation materials.

rows.title: Pesticide Handlers, Sprayers, and Applicators, Vegetation
rows.description: Mix or apply pesticides, herbicides, fungicides, or insecticides through sprays, dusts, vapors, soil incorporation, or chemical application on trees, shrubs, lawns, or crops. Usually requires specific training and state or federal certification.

rows.title: Roof Bolters, Mining
rows.description: Operate machinery to install roof support bolts in underground mine.

rows.title: Ophthalmic Laboratory Technicians
rows.description: Cut, grind, and polish eyeglasses, contact lenses, or other precision optical elements. Assemble and mount lenses into frames or process other optical elements. Includes precision lens polishers or grinders, centerer-edgers, and lens mounters.

rows.title: Cutting and Slicing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
rows.description: Set up, operate, or tend machines that cut or slice materials, such as glass, stone, cork, rubber, tobacco, food, paper, or insulating material.

rows.title: Grinding and Polishing Workers, Hand
rows.description: Grind, sand, or polish, using hand tools or hand-held power tools, a variety of metal, wood, stone, clay, plastic, or glass objects. Includes chippers, buffers, and finishers.

rows.title: Grinding, Lapping, Polishing, and Buffing Machine Tool Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
rows.description: Set up, operate, or tend grinding and related tools that remove excess material or burrs from surfaces, sharpen edges or corners, or buff, hone, or polish metal or plastic work pieces.

rows.title: Helpers--Extraction Workers
rows.description: Help extraction craft workers, such as earth drillers, blasters and explosives workers, derrick operators, and mining machine operators, by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include supplying equipment or cleaning work area.

rows.title: Lathe and Turning Machine Tool Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
rows.description: Set up, operate, or tend lathe and turning machines to turn, bore, thread, form, or face metal or plastic materials, such as wire, rod, or bar stock.

rows.title: Paperhangers
rows.description: Cover interior walls or ceilings of rooms with decorative wallpaper or fabric, or attach advertising posters on surfaces such as walls and billboards. May remove old materials or prepare surfaces to be papered.

rows.title: Rail Car Repairers
rows.description: Diagnose, adjust, repair, or overhaul railroad rolling stock, mine cars, or mass transit rail cars.

rows.title: Stockers and Order Fillers
rows.description: Receive, store, and issue merchandise, materials, equipment, and other items from stockroom, warehouse, or storage yard to fill shelves, racks, tables, or customers' orders. May operate power equipment to fill orders. May mark prices on merchandise and set up sales displays.

rows.title: Stone Cutters and Carvers, Manufacturing
rows.description: Cut or carve stone according to diagrams and patterns.

rows.title: Structural Iron and Steel Workers
rows.description: Raise, place, and unite iron or steel girders, columns, and other structural members to form completed structures or structural frameworks. May erect metal storage tanks and assemble prefabricated metal buildings.

rows.title: Textile Knitting and Weaving Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
rows.description: Set up, operate, or tend machines that knit, loop, weave, or draw in textiles.

rows.title: Timing Device Assemblers and Adjusters
rows.description: Perform precision assembling or adjusting, within narrow tolerances, of timing devices such as digital clocks or timing devices with electrical or electronic components.

rows.title: Recycling and Reclamation Workers
rows.description: Prepare and sort materials or products for recycling. Identify and remove hazardous substances. Dismantle components of products such as appliances.

rows.title: Fence Erectors
rows.description: Erect and repair fences and fence gates, using hand and power tools.

rows.title: Janitors and Cleaners, Except Maids and Housekeeping Cleaners
rows.description: Keep buildings in clean and orderly condition. Perform heavy cleaning duties, such as cleaning floors, shampooing rugs, washing walls and glass, and removing rubbish. Duties may include tending furnace and boiler, performing routine maintenance activities, notifying management of need for repairs, and cleaning snow or debris from sidewalk.

rows.title: Plasterers and Stucco Masons
rows.description: Apply interior or exterior plaster, cement, stucco, or similar materials. May also set ornamental plaster.

rows.title: Textile Cutting Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
rows.description: Set up, operate, or tend machines that cut textiles.

rows.title: Painting, Coating, and Decorating Workers
rows.description: Paint, coat, or decorate articles, such as furniture, glass, plateware, pottery, jewelry, toys, books, or leather.

rows.title: Packaging and Filling Machine Operators and Tenders
rows.description: Operate or tend machines to prepare industrial or consumer products for storage or shipment. Includes cannery workers who pack food products.

rows.title: Paving, Surfacing, and Tamping Equipment Operators
rows.description: Operate equipment used for applying concrete, asphalt, or other materials to road beds, parking lots, or airport runways and taxiways or for tamping gravel, dirt, or other materials. Includes concrete and asphalt paving machine operators, form tampers, tamping machine operators, and stone spreader operators.

rows.title: Shoe and Leather Workers and Repairers
rows.description: Construct, decorate, or repair leather and leather-like products, such as luggage, shoes, and saddles. May use hand tools.

rows.title: Tool Grinders, Filers, and Sharpeners
rows.description: Perform precision smoothing, sharpening, polishing, or grinding of metal objects.

rows.title: Helpers--Painters, Paperhangers, Plasterers, and Stucco Masons
rows.description: Help painters, paperhangers, plasterers, or stucco masons by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include using, supplying, or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

rows.title: Electrical and Electronic Equipment Assemblers
rows.description: Assemble or modify electrical or electronic equipment, such as computers, test equipment telemetering systems, electric motors, and batteries.

rows.title: Model Makers, Metal and Plastic
rows.description: Set up and operate machines, such as lathes, milling and engraving machines, and jig borers to make working models of metal or plastic objects. Includes template makers.

rows.title: Pile Driver Operators
rows.description: Operate pile drivers mounted on skids, barges, crawler treads, or locomotive cranes to drive pilings for retaining walls, bulkheads, and foundations of structures such as buildings, bridges, and piers.

rows.title: Dining Room and Cafeteria Attendants and Bartender Helpers
rows.description: Facilitate food service. Clean tables; remove dirty dishes; replace soiled table linens; set tables; replenish supply of clean linens, silverware, glassware, and dishes; supply service bar with food; and serve items such as water, condiments, and coffee to patrons.

rows.title: Pourers and Casters, Metal
rows.description: Operate hand-controlled mechanisms to pour and regulate the flow of molten metal into molds to produce castings or ingots.

rows.title: Dredge Operators
rows.description: Operate dredge to remove sand, gravel, or other materials in order to excavate and maintain navigable channels in waterways.

rows.title: Floor Sanders and Finishers
rows.description: Scrape and sand wooden floors to smooth surfaces using floor scraper and floor sanding machine, and apply coats of finish.

rows.title: Logging Equipment Operators
rows.description: Drive logging tractor or wheeled vehicle equipped with one or more accessories, such as bulldozer blade, frontal shear, grapple, logging arch, cable winches, hoisting rack, or crane boom, to fell tree; to skid, load, unload, or stack logs; or to pull stumps or clear brush. Includes operating stand-alone logging machines, such as log chippers.

rows.title: Cooks, Fast Food
rows.description: Prepare and cook food in a fast food restaurant with a limited menu. Duties of these cooks are limited to preparation of a few basic items and normally involve operating large-volume single-purpose cooking equipment.

rows.title: Molders, Shapers, and Casters, Except Metal and Plastic
rows.description: Mold, shape, form, cast, or carve products such as food products, figurines, tile, pipes, and candles consisting of clay, glass, plaster, concrete, stone, or combinations of materials.

rows.title: Rock Splitters, Quarry
rows.description: Separate blocks of rough dimension stone from quarry mass using jackhammers, wedges, or chop saws.

rows.title: Cutters and Trimmers, Hand
rows.description: Use hand tools or hand-held power tools to cut and trim a variety of manufactured items, such as carpet, fabric, stone, glass, or rubber.

rows.title: Food Preparation Workers
rows.description: Perform a variety of food preparation duties other than cooking, such as preparing cold foods and shellfish, slicing meat, and brewing coffee or tea.

rows.title: Fallers
rows.description: Use axes or chainsaws to fell trees using knowledge of tree characteristics and cutting techniques to control direction of fall and minimize tree damage.

rows.title: Maids and Housekeeping Cleaners
rows.description: Perform any combination of light cleaning duties to maintain private households or commercial establishments, such as hotels and hospitals, in a clean and orderly manner. Duties may include making beds, replenishing linens, cleaning rooms and halls, and vacuuming.

rows.title: Tire Repairers and Changers
rows.description: Repair and replace tires.

rows.title: Cleaning, Washing, and Metal Pickling Equipment Operators and Tenders
rows.description: Operate or tend machines to wash or clean products, such as barrels or kegs, glass items, tin plate, food, pulp, coal, plastic, or rubber, to remove impurities.

rows.title: Graders and Sorters, Agricultural Products
rows.description: Grade, sort, or classify unprocessed food and other agricultural products by size, weight, color, or condition.

rows.title: Refuse and Recyclable Material Collectors
rows.description: Collect and dump refuse or recyclable materials from containers into truck. May drive truck.

rows.title: Industrial Truck and Tractor Operators
rows.description: Operate industrial trucks or tractors equipped to move materials around a warehouse, storage yard, factory, construction site, or similar location.

rows.title: Laborers and Freight, Stock, and Material Movers, Hand
rows.description: Manually move freight, stock, luggage, or other materials, or perform other general labor. Includes all manual laborers not elsewhere classified.

rows.title: Roustabouts, Oil and Gas
rows.description: Assemble or repair oil field equipment using hand and power tools. Perform other tasks as needed.

rows.title: Helpers--Production Workers
rows.description: Help production workers by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include supplying or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

rows.title: Food Cooking Machine Operators and Tenders
rows.description: Operate or tend cooking equipment, such as steam cooking vats, deep fry cookers, pressure cookers, kettles, and boilers, to prepare food products.

rows.title: Rail-Track Laying and Maintenance Equipment Operators
rows.description: Lay, repair, and maintain track for standard or narrow-gauge railroad equipment used in regular railroad service or in plant yards, quarries, sand and gravel pits, and mines. Includes ballast cleaning machine operators and railroad bed tamping machine operators.

rows.title: Helpers--Pipelayers, Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters
rows.description: Help plumbers, pipefitters, steamfitters, or pipelayers by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include using, supplying, or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

rows.title: Tire Builders
rows.description: Operate machines to build tires.

rows.title: Helpers--Brickmasons, Blockmasons, Stonemasons, and Tile and Marble Setters
rows.description: Help brickmasons, blockmasons, stonemasons, or tile and marble setters by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include using, supplying, or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

rows.title: Terrazzo Workers and Finishers
rows.description: Apply a mixture of cement, sand, pigment, or marble chips to floors, stairways, and cabinet fixtures to fashion durable and decorative surfaces.

rows.title: Fast Food and Counter Workers
rows.description: Perform duties such as taking orders and serving food and beverages. Serve customers at counter or from a steam table. May take payment. May prepare food and beverages.

rows.title: Helpers--Roofers
rows.description: Help roofers by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include using, supplying, or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

rows.title: Models
rows.description: Model garments or other apparel and accessories for prospective buyers at fashion shows, private showings, or retail establishments. May pose for photos to be used in magazines or advertisements. May pose as subject for paintings, sculptures, and other types of artistic expression.

rows.title: Sawing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Wood
rows.description: Set up, operate, or tend wood sawing machines. May operate computer numerically controlled (CNC) equipment. Includes lead sawyers.

rows.title: Slaughterers and Meat Packers
rows.description: Perform nonroutine or precision functions involving the preparation of large portions of meat. Work may include specialized slaughtering tasks, cutting standard or premium cuts of meat for marketing, making sausage, or wrapping meats. Work typically occurs in slaughtering, meat packing, or wholesale establishments.

rows.title: Coating, Painting, and Spraying Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
rows.description: Set up, operate, or tend spraying or rolling machines to coat or paint any of a wide variety of products, including glassware, cloth, ceramics, metal, plastic, paper, or wood, with lacquer, silver, copper, rubber, varnish, glaze, enamel, oil, or rust-proofing materials. Includes painters of transportation vehicles such as painters in auto body repair facilities.

rows.title: Laundry and Dry-Cleaning Workers
rows.description: Operate or tend washing or dry-cleaning machines to wash or dry-clean industrial or household articles, such as cloth garments, suede, leather, furs, blankets, draperies, linens, rugs, and carpets. Includes spotters and dyers of these articles.

rows.title: Packers and Packagers, Hand
rows.description: Pack or package by hand a wide variety of products and materials.

rows.title: Reinforcing Iron and Rebar Workers
rows.description: Position and secure steel bars or mesh in concrete forms in order to reinforce concrete. Use a variety of fasteners, rod-bending machines, blowtorches, and hand tools. Includes rod busters.

rows.title: Foundry Mold and Coremakers
rows.description: Make or form wax or sand cores or molds used in the production of metal castings in foundries.

rows.title: Painters, Construction and Maintenance
rows.description: Paint walls, equipment, buildings, bridges, and other structural surfaces, using brushes, rollers, and spray guns. May remove old paint to prepare surface prior to painting. May mix colors or oils to obtain desired color or consistency.

rows.title: Tapers
rows.description: Seal joints between plasterboard or other wallboard to prepare wall surface for painting or papering.

rows.title: Welders, Cutters, Solderers, and Brazers
rows.description: Use hand-welding, flame-cutting, hand-soldering, or brazing equipment to weld or join metal components or to fill holes, indentations, or seams of fabricated metal products.

rows.title: Cleaners of Vehicles and Equipment
rows.description: Wash or otherwise clean vehicles, machinery, and other equipment. Use such materials as water, cleaning agents, brushes, cloths, and hoses.

rows.title: Dishwashers
rows.description: Clean dishes, kitchen, food preparation equipment, or utensils.

rows.title: Sewers, Hand
rows.description: Sew, join, reinforce, or finish, usually with needle and thread, a variety of manufactured items. Includes weavers and stitchers.

rows.title: Landscaping and Groundskeeping Workers
rows.description: Landscape or maintain grounds of property using hand or power tools or equipment. Workers typically perform a variety of tasks, which may include any combination of the following: sod laying, mowing, trimming, planting, watering, fertilizing, digging, raking, sprinkler installation, and installation of mortarless segmental concrete masonry wall units.

rows.title: Sewing Machine Operators
rows.description: Operate or tend sewing machines to join, reinforce, decorate, or perform related sewing operations in the manufacture of garment or nongarment products.

rows.title: Pressers, Textile, Garment, and Related Materials
rows.description: Press or shape articles by hand or machine.
